name: Trust Them
description: Copy the top rival’s answer to this question and their answer speed. Their mistakes count too.

name: Double or Nothing
description: Flip a coin after the answer: double this question’s positive points, or earn zero.

name: Siphon Points
description: Absorb 50% of a rival’s question points. If they lose points, share their loss.

name: Walker's Weapon
description: A suspiciously helpful chatbot privately types the correct answer, word by word.

name: Cold Feet
description: Freeze everyone else for three seconds while the clock is paused. You can still answer.

name: Hot Streak
description: Boost your streak’s cash-out value ×5, up to ×25. Wear a phoenix until the streak ends.

name: Water
description: Extinguish everyone else’s streak after the answer. Yours stays. Once per game.

name: Think Fast
description: This question has exactly ten answering seconds. Announcements do not use that time.

name: Cash in Streak
description: Trade your streak for 100 × streak × boost points. Watch the streak turn into points.

name: Pond Casino
description: Play blackjack on your phone while everyone watches. Bet up to 1,000 quiz points; wins pay 1:1.

name: Nope!
description: Skip this question for everyone. Keep streaks and refund other used items. Once per game.

name: Sucker
description: If six or more racers answer incorrectly, double your positive question points.

name: The Intern
description: Your intern answers for you. Exactly 50% chance of being right; a correct answer pays ×1.5.

name: Hot Potato
description: Tap the potato to pass it to a random rival. Its final holder earns half their positive question points.

name: Prediction
description: Secretly predict the first racer to submit a manual answer. Get it right to double your positive question points.

name: Ribbit
description: Everyone becomes Frog on the next leaderboard. Scores and real identities remain unchanged.

name: Participation Trophy
description: Claim first place on the final podium. Your score and the official score-ranked standings do not change.

name: Taxes
description: Every racer above you at question start contributes 100 points after the answer.

name: Uno Reverse Card
description: Reflect the first attack against you. For attacks that spare their user, you get that protection and they lose it.

name: Blue Shell
description: The first manual answer earns half its positive question points. Being correct will not save them.

name: Bill
description: Replace a rival’s answer text with “I miss Bill” for the first five playable seconds.

name: 200WPM
description: Answer correctly within five scoring seconds to double this question’s points.

name: Skip
description: Skip the question only for yourself. Collect 500 points and keep your streak.
